scope: Pin the existing Preview browser job to Playwright-supported Ubuntu24.04 and make two voice usage fixtures calendar-stable, with explicit next-month recovery coverage.
riskAnalysis: Workflow OS selection affects release qualification. Only runner/cache, refreshed source fingerprint and tests change. Production code, permissions, credentials, spending, grants and visual baselines remain unchanged.

threatModel.assets: Exact source qualification, existing authentication secrets and immutable failure history.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: GitHub hosted runner versus protected Preview; deterministic fixture clock versus production accounting.
threatModel.abuseCases: Reuse incompatible browser cache, hide test failure by changing expected usage, confuse fixture success with hosted or live model success.
threatModel.mitigations: Pin OS and cache identity; retain original minute expectations with test-scoped clock and add cross-month historical-ledger check; qualify exact successor source.

defects.rootCause: Floating ubuntu-latest advanced to Ubuntu26.04, unsupported by installed Playwright1.55.
defects.detectionGap: Host OS was not pinned alongside the browser version.
defects.regression: Existing workflow/source/access tests33passed; hosted browser required on corrected OS.
defects.historicalPrevention: OS-specific cache and pinned supported runner preserve dependency compatibility; original failed run remains.

defects.rootCause: Two October call fixtures asserted current-month usage against an uncontrolled November wall clock.
defects.detectionGap: Fixtures passed in October and did not specify the billing month being tested.
defects.regression: Both failures reproduced; scoped Date mock retains assertions; next-month recovery preserves original ledger and excludes historical minutes. Full voice suite72passed.
defects.historicalPrevention: No changing fixture dates each month or weakening expected usage. Added explicit calendar transition and replay coverage.

rollback: Keep execution disabled if qualification fails. Revert reviewed feature changes while retaining original CI failures and audit records. Never change Production or restore consumed authority.

negativePaths.malformed-response: No response parser changed; existing fixture validation remains mandatory.
negativePaths.stale-state: Cache key includes pinned OS; exact source fingerprint must match successor deployment.
negativePaths.concurrency: No worker or ledger concurrency changes; full suite still tests existing CAS behavior.
negativePaths.cancellation: Workflow cancellation and cleanup steps unchanged; no paid operations initiated.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: No restricted worker code changed; existing cleanup verification retained.
negativePaths.api-outage: Provider and access errors still fail release qualification; no retries or bypass added.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Job permissions, protected access and owner checks unchanged.
negativePaths.spending-limit: No accounting changes or new paid execution; one normal source build only after reviewed commit.
negativePaths.partial-execution: Original pre-application browser failure and failed voice assertions preserved; no claim partial run passed.

proactiveReview.architecture: Reuse existing release workflows; no added orchestration, gateway or infrastructure.
proactiveReview.dependencies: Existing Playwright1.55 package supports Ubuntu24.04; browser version unchanged.
proactiveReview.threats: OS/cache mismatch corrected without changing secrets, permissions or network boundaries.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Calendar rollover reproduced locally; production monthly attribution confirmed in source.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Next-month delayed transcript and duplicate replay validate preserved historical ledger and zero current usage.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Independent Work QA and Engineering Auditor review the narrow follow-up before publication.
proactiveReview.recovery: Retain all historical checkpoint bytes and original failed job identities; no duplicate deployment.
proactiveReview.readiness: Runner33 and voice72 tests pass; full exact-source CI/Redis/CodeQL/Jekyll/Browser evidence remains required.
